VOLUME, ADOPTION AND MARKET EXPANSION
G4-G6 | Shopify Payments
|
|-- Volume is weighted by merchant sales
|   |-- [R] FY25 GPV $248.1B; penetration 65.6%
|   |-- [R] GPV +$67.2B, or 37%, versus FY24
|   |-- [S] Q1 2026: $67B GPV; 67% penetration
|   `-- [S] Q2 2026: 68% penetration
|
|-- Adoption counts merchants, not their GMV
|   |-- [R] FY24 -> FY25: NA 91% -> 88%
|   |-- [R] APAC 90% -> 89%; EMEA 86% -> 83%
|   |-- [S] Filing narrative attributes decline to market expansion.
|   `-- [I] Regional mix and cohort data are insufficient to reconcile it.
|
|-- G5 Geography / lifecycle
|   |-- Expand: [S] Germany launched 2018; early double-digit adoption
|   |-- Focused compounding: [S] 23 markets FY24 -> 39 in Q1 2025
|   |-- [S] Q1 2025 launches: 15 European markets plus Mexico
|   |-- Reacceleration: [S] UAE launch Q2 2026 brings total to 40
|   `-- [X] Literal "60 new countries" conflicts with 39/40 totals.
|
`-- G5 Capability expansion / mechanism claims
    |-- [S] PayPal and Klarna contribute to Q1 2025 penetration.
    |-- [S] Multi-entity support launched May 2025.
    |-- [S] USDC live by Q4 2025.
    |-- [S] Q2 2026: dynamic display of relevant payment methods
    |-- Relevant methods -[D:claim]-> better checkout conversion
    `-- [S] Europe mix initially dilutes global penetration.
GPV = gross payments volume; country counts here are call statements.
